title: Apple beats quarterly earnings expectations
body:
Apple reported quarterly revenue of $91.2 billion, ahead of analyst expectations.

Chief executive Tim Cook said the company’s services business carried the quarter. Guidance for the December quarter was raised.

title: Apple unveils new on-device translation feature
body: At a press event in Cupertino, Apple announced a product update that adds on-device translation. The launch is planned for October, and the feature runs without a network connection.

title: Regulator opens investigation into Tesla driver-assist claims
body: A federal regulator opened an investigation into Tesla’s marketing of its driver-assist software. The company said it would cooperate. A separate lawsuit over the same claims was settled last year.

title: Analyst cuts Tesla price target on margin pressure
body: Shares of Tesla fell after an analyst downgrade. The note cited margin pressure from price cuts and set a price target of $198 – down from $240.

title: Tesla energy division reports record quarter
body: Tesla’s energy storage division reported record quarterly revenue of $3.1 billion. Elon Musk called the result “the start of the ramp” in a post, and the profit contribution reached an all-time high.

title: Netflix café documentary draws festival praise
body: A Netflix documentary about a Parisian café drew praise at a film festival… Attendance figures were not disclosed, and the platform said nothing about renewal plans.
